name: FindAba City OS
description: FindAba City OS by SANDALSroyalle is the comprehensive city platform built for Enyimba City (Aba, Nigeria), connecting everyone—from master artisans and traders to schools, hospitals, and professional services—to the global digital economy. It unifies AI-powered discovery, creative production, secure trade, and smart logistics into one modern operating system for the world's workshop and beyond.
